name: cskel27
note: The driven layout: the joints a motion take writes, in the order it writes them. The order is load-bearing — a take's rotation array is indexed by it, and getting it wrong does not error, it silently animates the wrong limb. Every joint here is a driven bone of contract.json; the contract's remaining bones are skinnable leaves no clip ever animates. contact_columns is the order of a take's per-frame foot-contact columns, left side first, which is the reverse of the joint order (right leg before left). arm_joints is the set an exaggerate knob scales: arms only, so foot contacts survive and torso pitch does not lurch.
